definitions.full: H8160. shaah II. [ שַׁ֫עַר ] noun [masculine] measure (properly reckoning ); — plural שְׁעָרִים מֵאָה Gen 26:12 (J) 100 measures , i.e. 100 for one = 100-fold. III. שׁער (√of following). שָׁעָה noun feminine brief time, moment ( ᵑ7 id. , שָֽׁעֲתָא , Late Hebrew שָׁעָה time, hour ; Syriac moment , then hour Brock 369 , but Christian-Palestinian Aramaic moment, hour Schw Idioticon 97 Schulth Lex.211 ; perhaps = Assyrian šattu, duration; Tel Amarna 91, 77 še-ti , time, hour (as Canaanism) Wkl KAT 3. 335 ; Arabic , portion of time, Ethiopic time , hour, time (Buhl calls Arabic Ethiopic loan-words, but see Wkl l.c ); √ unknown: possibly Assyrian loan-word (see Wkl l.c ); Dl Pr 39 f. conjecture* שׁיע = שָׁעָה look , hence moment = 'Augenblick,' but verb ׳שׁ rather of steadygaze); — moment: usually emphatic בַּהּשַֿׁעֲתָא (read possibly ׳שָֽׁ as ᵑ7 Syriac, M 86* f. Buhl 14 compare variant reading in Str) in the same moment, forthwith Dan 3:6 , 15 ; 4:30 ; 5:5 ; absolute חֲדָה שָׁעָה 4:16 for a moment .
